## Service: oauth (OAuth 2.0 v3)

Documentation for OAuth 2.0 API

**API Version v3**

All APIs available via `/v3` route prefix with AIP-compliant responses.

### Get Access Token
POST /oauth/token
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/oauth/token
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/oauth/get-access-token | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/oauth/get-access-token.md

Use Access Tokens to access CRM resources on behalf of an authenticated location/company.

Auth: none (no security requirement declared; send no Authorization header)

Headers:
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/x-www-form-urlencoded) GetAccessTokenBodyDto:
- client_id* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - The ID provided by CRM for your integration
- client_secret* string (e.g. "ab12dc0ae1234a7898f9ff06d4f69gh") - The client secret provided by CRM for your integration
- grant_type* string (enum: authorization_code | refresh_token | client_credentials; e.g. "authorization_code") - The OAuth2 grant type — authorization_code, refresh_token, or client_credentials
- code string (e.g. "ab12dc0ae1234a7898f9ff06d4f69gh") - The authorization code received from the authorization endpoint (required for authorization_code grant)
- refresh_token string (e.g. "xy34dc0ae1234a4858f9ff06d4f66ba") - The refresh token used to obtain a new access token (required for refresh_token grant)
- user_type string (enum: Company | Location; e.g. "Location") - The type of token to be requested
- redirect_uri string (e.g. "https://myapp.com/oauth/callback/crm") - The redirect URI for your application

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- access_token string - The OAuth2 access token
- token_type string - The token type (always Bearer)
- expires_in number - Time in seconds until the access token expires
- refresh_token string - The OAuth2 refresh token used to obtain a new access token
- scope string - Space-separated list of scopes the access token has access to
- userType string - The user type associated with the token (Location or Company)
- locationId string - Location ID - Present only for Sub-Account Access Token
- companyId string - Company ID
- approvedLocations string[] - Approved locations to generate location access token
- userId* string - USER ID - Represent user id of person who performed installation
- planId string - Plan Id of the subscribed plan in paid apps.
- isBulkInstallation boolean - Indicates whether the installation was performed as a bulk installation
- installToFutureLocations boolean - Boolean to control if user wants app to be automatically installed to future locations (only for company tokens)
- approveAllLocations boolean - Boolean indicating if user approved all locations during bulk installation (only for company tokens)

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Get Location where app is installed
GET /oauth/installed-locations
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/oauth/installed-locations
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/oauth/get-installed-location | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/oauth/get-installed-location.md

This API allows you fetch location where app is installed upon

Auth: Agency token: OAuth access token only (Private Integration Tokens are not accepted). Scopes: oauth.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- pageSize number (default: 20) - Max items per page (1-100). Replaces legacy `limit` parameter per AIP-158.
- pageToken string (e.g. "eyJza2lwIjoyMH0") - Opaque token returned in a previous response to fetch the next page. Replaces legacy `skip` parameter per AIP-158.
- query string (maxLength: 100; e.g. "location name") - Literal installed-location name search. Leading and trailing whitespace is ignored.
- isInstalled boolean - Filters out location which are installed for specified app under the specified company
- restrictToUserLocations boolean - When true, restricts the list to locations the current user has access to (for restricted agency admins and account admins). When false or omitted, no user-based filter is applied for installed list; for backward compatibility, install list (isInstalled=false) is still filtered by user when this param is omitted.
- companyId* string (e.g. "tDtDnQdgm2LXpyiqYvZ6") - Parameter to search by the companyId
- appId* string (e.g. "tDtDnQdgm2LXpyiqYvZ6") - Parameter to search by the appId
- versionId string (e.g. "tDtDnQdgm2LXpyiqYvZ6") - VersionId of the app
- onTrial boolean - Filters out locations which are installed for specified app in trial mode
- planId string - Filters out location which are installed for specified app under the specified planId
- locationId string (e.g. "1245") - locationId

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- items* object[] - List of locations with their installation status for the requested app
  - _id* string - Location ID
  - name* string - Name of the location
  - address* string - Address linked to location
  - isInstalled boolean - Check if the requested app is installed for following location
  - versionId string - Version ID of the installed app version for this location
  - installedAt string (format: date-time) - Timestamp when the app was installed on this location
- pagination* object - Pagination metadata (AIP-158)
  - totalRecords number - Total number of records matching the query across all pages
  - hasNextPage* boolean - True when a next page is available
  - hasPrevPage* boolean - True when a previous page is available
  - nextPageToken string - Opaque token to fetch the next page
  - prevPageToken string - Opaque token to fetch the previous page
  - currentPageSize* number - Number of items returned in the current page
  - estimatedTotalRecords number - Estimated total records; present when exact total is unknown
- metadata object - Query metadata (filters and sort applied)
  - filterApplied object - Filters that were applied to the query
  - sortApplied object - Sort order that was applied to the query
- installToFutureLocations boolean - Boolean to control if user wants app to be automatically installed to future locations

Errors: 400, 401, 404, 422 (401, 422: see Common error responses)
Response 400 (Invalid argument (AIP error envelope)) application/json:
- error* object - AIP-compliant error envelope
  - code* string - Machine-readable error code (see AipErrorCode enum in @platform-core/aip-framework)
  - message* string - Human-readable error message
  - details object - Additional error context (field name, identifier, etc.)
  - resolution string - Suggested resolution for the caller
Response 404 (App not found (AIP error envelope)) application/json:
- error* object - AIP-compliant error envelope
  - code* string - Machine-readable error code (see AipErrorCode enum in @platform-core/aip-framework)
  - message* string - Human-readable error message
  - details object - Additional error context (field name, identifier, etc.)
  - resolution string - Suggested resolution for the caller

### Get Location Access Token from Agency Token
POST /oauth/location-token
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/oauth/location-token
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/oauth/get-location-access-token | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/oauth/get-location-access-token.md

This API allows you to generate locationAccessToken from AgencyAccessToken

Auth: Agency token: OAuth access token only (Private Integration Tokens are not accepted). Scopes: oauth.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/x-www-form-urlencoded) GetLocationAccessCodeBodyDto:
- companyId* string (e.g. "tDtDnQdgm2LXpyiqYvZ6") - Company Id of location you want to request token for
- locationId* string (e.g. "l1C08ntBrFjLS0elLIYU") - The location ID for which you want to obtain accessToken

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- access_token string - Location access token which can be used to authenticate & authorize API under following scope
- token_type string - The token type (always Bearer)
- expires_in number - Time in seconds remaining for token to expire
- scope string - Scopes the following accessToken have access to
- locationId string - Location ID - Present only for Sub-Account Access Token
- planId string - Plan Id of the subscribed plan in paid apps.
- userId* string - USER ID - Represent user id of person who performed installation
- appId string - App ID of the installed application
- versionId string - Version ID of the installed app version
- refresh_token string - The OAuth2 refresh token used to obtain a new access token for this specific location.

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)
